text:
Lena CS: quick sync for Copperline private/VPC onboarding. Goal: get audit logs into their Splunk tenant, finalize IAM trust, KMS access, and confirm rotation plan. Renewal rep flagged risk if audit not validated by next Thurs. Can we call out blockers?
Marta (Copperline): main blockers: logs failing TLS handshake, our ops needs the exact role ARN to add to the sidecar trust policy, and KMS policy changes pending.
Raj (Net): seeing TLS handshake failures from forwarder IPs. Marta, please confirm Splunk collector IPs and whether they expect client certs.
Marta (Copperline): collectors: splunk-a.copperline.net (34.88.99.10) and splunk-b.copperline.net (34.88.99.11). They accept TLS only; no mTLS required.
Raj (Net): will open egress to those two IPs and restrict to tcp/8088. ETA 20m. Snippet: aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0c0ffee --protocol tcp --port 8088 --cidr 34.88.99.10/32
Ivy (SE): IAM role to use: arn:aws:iam::666555444333:role/copperline-log-writer. Also, KMS: we need to allow kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey for that role, scoped by encryption context key "source":"copperline-logs".
Connor (Security): agree. Policy stanza: {"Sid":"AllowCopperlineLogs","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::666555444333:role/copperline-log-writer"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:EncryptionContext:source":"copperline-logs"}}} Apply to customer CMK.
Ivy (SE): propose key rotation Fri 04:00 UTC (low traffic). Marta, ok?
Marta (Copperline): Fri 04:00 UTC works. We'll pause ingestion for ~10m and verify.
Lena CS: action items: 1) Raj apply egress rule to Splunk IPs (ETA 20m). 2) Connor to post final KMS JSON (ETA 2h). 3) Ivy to schedule rotation Fri 04:00 UTC and send invite. 4) Marta to paste a sample post-rotation log and confirm Splunk index. Note renewal touch next Thurs; we need audit delivery + rotation validated by EOD Fri to avoid escalation.
ops-bot: forwarder-job #4121 started -> status: running.
Raj (Net): egress rules applied, verified TCP connect to both collectors from a test instance.
ops-bot: forwarder-job #4121 finished -> status: success, 0 errors.
Marta (Copperline): re-tested after firewall change: now seeing HTTP 200 from the collectors. sample: \"{\"ts\":\"2026-03-22T16:45:00Z\",\"status\":200,\"msg\":\"ingest accepted to splunk index=prod-logs\"}\"
Lena CS: good momentum. Marking thread in-flight. I'll post a concise health snapshot before the renewal check-in. If anything regresses, escalate to CS lead.
